principle: A ladder is a traversal RULE (nav + collision + socket + animation + accepted-contact climb), NOT a static mesh. Deployed object, physically climbed. No pocket ladders; no mid-battle construction.

preparation_flag.label: VCS
preparation_flag.note: FSoulSiegeRules::CanAssaultWalls() already returns true when bLadders is set (Source/SoulCore/Private/SoulSiege.cpp). But the arena constructs siege with FSoulSiegeRules::Begin({}) (SoulRealtimeBattleArena.cpp:1264), so bLadders is never populated. V1 must transport it (feature B1).

wall_layer_enum.label: VCS
wall_layer_enum.note: AdvanceLayer defines OuterField->Walls->InnerSettlement->Keep but only the gate/breach path drives it today. A ladder that reaches the wall-top should advance to ::Walls.

ranged_defender.label: VCS
ranged_defender.note: Archers exist (bow reach 2600). They are the natural ranged counter to climbers. CommitSiegeHit rejects bRanged from the gate (line ~ CommitSiegeHit), so ladders give melee a route that ranged can suppress.

owned_ladder_animation.label: VOA
owned_ladder_animation.note: Owned per catalog; NOT confirmed locally present or imported. Climb animation suitability vs Soul's RB character rig is LRC.

requirements.title: Deployable ladder actor (not a decorative mesh)
requirements.label: DP
requirements.statement: A placeable ASoulSiegeLadderActor that an attacker preparation (bLadders) brings onto the field at authored deploy anchors near a wall segment. Mirrors ASoulFortificationSegmentActor's authored-anchor pattern.
acceptance: Ladder exists physically before any climb (no pocket ladder, no mid-battle construction).
Ladder count is bounded by preparation, not infinite.
Ladder actor carries SettlementId + WallSegmentId linkage like ASoulFortificationSegmentActor carries SettlementId/SegmentId.

requirements.title: Authored wall-top standable nav island
requirements.label: LRC
requirements.statement: The battlement surface of L_HumanCapital_Authored must be walkable (navmesh or authored path) and wide enough for a Soul combat capsule (capsule ~ 40 radius / 90 half-height per siege sweeps in SoulHumanCapitalSiege.cpp).
requirements.rationale: VCS: V0 only navigates the ground approach and the gate aperture. No wall-top navigation is proven. Ladders deliver ZERO value if there is nowhere to climb to. This is the single highest-risk unknown for ladders.

requirements.title: Ladder-top attach socket / landing transform
requirements.label: LRC
requirements.statement: A deterministic landing transform where a climber transitions from ladder to wall-top, analogous to the measured SiegeGateBase+offset transforms V0 computes.
acceptance: Landing transform is measured from authored geometry at setup, fail-closed if missing (mirror SetupSiege's SOUL_SIEGE_SETUP_FAIL discipline).
No hard-coded /Game paths; resolve from the authored map actors present at runtime.

requirements.title: Accepted-contact climb traversal
requirements.label: DP
requirements.statement: Climbing is a bounded traversal with a start gate (unit at ladder base, side==attacker, not ranged, ladder intact) and an end state (unit arrives at LADDER-R3 landing). Model after PerformGateMelee/CommitGateMelee's contact discipline, not a teleport.
acceptance: A climber is interruptible: killed/shoved mid-climb returns to ground or dies (see LADDER-R6).
Climb occupies the ladder; a bounded number of simultaneous climbers per ladder.
Climb does not disable collision globally; local avoidance handling mirrors the bounded RVO window used at the gate aperture (TickSiege).

requirements.title: Climb animation integration
requirements.label: LRC
requirements.statement: Use the owned Free Ladder Animation Set (VOA) climb clips through the existing visual-animation resolution path (ResolveVisualAnimation/PlayAnimation in SoulRealtimeBattleArena.cpp) IF the clips retarget to Soul's RB skeletal rig.
acceptance: If retarget fails or clips are not locally present, fall back to a non-animated but still rule-correct climb (functionality != mesh): the climb RULE must pass even if the fancy animation does not.
No claim of a working ladder is made from the mesh/animation existing in the catalog alone.

requirements.title: Defender counter: shove-off / ranged suppression
requirements.label: DP
requirements.statement: A defender on the wall (Phase D) can push a ladder off or an archer can suppress climbers, giving the ladder a real cost. Advances AdvanceLayer to ::Walls only when the wall-top is actually held.
acceptance: Shove-off removes climbers currently on that ladder (returns to ground / casualty by existing rout semantics, no synthetic kills).
A contested wall-top does not advance the layer, mirroring AdvanceCourtyard's 'living defender contests' rule.

requirements.title: Preparation + transport wiring
requirements.label: DP
requirements.statement: bLadders is set by campaign siege preparation (Phase F), transported via FSoulCampaignBattleDescriptor, and passed to FSoulSiegeRules::Begin(Prep).
acceptance: No ladders spawn when bLadders is false.
CanAssaultWalls already honors bLadders (VCS) — reuse, do not duplicate.

local_validation_ids.LADDER-NAV-1: Wall-top navmesh/path exists and is capsule-wide in L_HumanCapital_Authored (BLOCKING).
local_validation_ids.LADDER-COL-1: Ladder + wall-top collision is solid; climb does not fall through or clip; aperture-style bounded avoidance works.
local_validation_ids.LADDER-SOCKET-1: Deterministic ladder-base deploy anchor and ladder-top landing transform are measurable from authored actors, fail-closed if absent.
local_validation_ids.LADDER-ANIM-1: Free Ladder Animation Set clips are locally present AND retarget to the RB rig; else rule-only fallback.

explicit_unknowns: Does L_HumanCapital_Authored have ANY walkable battlement? (LRC, BLOCKING for all ladder value.)
Is the Free Ladder Animation Set locally downloaded and import-compatible with Soul's RB skeleton? (VOA says owned, not local, not imported.)
Wall segment heights at the authored capital are unknown; ladder length / climb duration cannot be specified until measured in-editor (LRC).

No owned product in the catalog is named for the /Game/CastleTown kit that provides the current SM_Portcullis; ladder-and-wall mesh source for the authored map is Soul-owned content, not a catalogued Fab product (LRC).
anti_requirements: No global collision disable during climb.
No second siege/combat authority; extend FSoulSiegeState/FSoulSiegePreparation only.
No invented /Game paths; resolve authored actors at runtime and fail closed.
